full: Project CASTOR — Renewal of the Lending Operations System
line: Replace LOS, the 14-year-old lending system, with a configurable platform that moves money from loan agreement to disbursement without anyone re-typing anything.
money: Approved in the Business Case, carried into the Project Charter. The single number Medici's Corporate Investment Board actually signed for.
One person-day = one person working one day. 3,100 of them over 26 months.
Jan 2026 → Jul 2028, from the first request to administrative closure.
€560,000 over, nearly all of it data migration. Reported at closing, not hidden.
In-house core team plus an outsourced platform implementation by Levallois Systems.
sc: Disbursement cycle time, instruction to value date
Time to onboard a new instrument
dates: Corporate Investment Board approves the request — item seven of the agenda
